# Vale Rovers onboarding checkpoint

Attendees: Ellie Thornbury, Lucy Ashdown (Vale Rovers), Nora Kestrel, Priya Raman, Aoife Brennan, Jamal Whitfield

- Member import dry run: 18,412 rows, 312 duplicates by email.
- Branding assets received; club theme for the Fan App in progress (NWA-303).
- Lucy: their old box office system contract ends 31 July. They need to sell on our platform before the first pre-season home game on 8 August.

**Decision:** Vale Rovers go live on **1 August 2026**. Hypercare until 30 September. Fallback: keep the old box office read-only for refunds until the end of August.

Risk: season ticket history and loyalty points from the old system are **not** in scope for go-live.
